title: Add debounced context button
acceptance: One outstanding request, cooldown, cancellation and rate limit.
evidence: edge/buttons.py and edge/context_client.py: 30ms release-to-arm debounce, one outstanding request, ten-second minimum interval retained through cancellation, capture+8s expiry, independent timer, cancellable network child and Pi session/frame binding.

No real camera, GPIO/button, public context deployment, Gemini API, physical audio or electrical acceptance claimed. See edge/CONTEXT_BUTTON.md and handoffs/CS-027-context-button-bondmila-20261017.md.

User confirmed no physical button installed and selected manual terminal input. edge/context_runtime.py and opt-in uploader flags share the original process/session/frame/clock, require explicit consent and verified primary-source state, and cancel on hazard, unavailable/stale source, input EOF/off and cleanup.
